subtitle.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider.cycl: The road to hell is open.
ability.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider_hell_: Summons the Hell Cycle out of the fire and mounts it; press again to send it back. W throttle, S brake and reverse, A/D steer, Space jump, Sprint drift (a long drift fills a boost), Shift dismount. On the bike: LMB chain lash (8 damage, 70 degree arc, sets alight), RMB hook and tow. Riding never breaks blocks: city folk, villagers and animals are only nudged aside, monsters in the way are hit (4-7). Johnny can ride it too.
ability.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider_trans: Johnny Blaze burns away into the Rider (2 s; the final flare pushes back and sets alight everything within 4 blocks). The Rider: +16 health, 8 armour, immune to fire and lava, the Hell Chain on the mouse (LMB lash combo 6/6/9, RMB hook: 14 blocks, 4 damage, pulls the body in). Press again to become Johnny.
ability.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider_hell_: On foot: a burning dash ahead (5 damage to everyone in the path, sets alight; 4 s cooldown). On the Hell Cycle: a 2 s hellfire boost, the bike rams whoever it meets (9 damage, hellfire, thrown up; 8 s cooldown).
ability.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider_chain: Whirls the burning chain round him for 1.5 s (3 damage every 0.4 s within 4.5 blocks, sets alight), then slams it down ahead: 10 damage within 6 blocks; a hooked body is swung round and smashed down (+6).
ability.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider_hellf: Sweeps a wave of hellfire along the ground: an 11-block cone, 8 damage, knockback, burns for 5 s.
ability.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider_penan: The Rider on foot locks the eyes of a soul within 10 blocks for 2.5 s. The damage comes only from real deeds: 6 + 2.5 per sin (a killed player is 5 sins, a killed innocent 3, every 10 damage dealt 1), at most 40. An innocent soul takes nothing and the cooldown is only 10 s. Moving away beyond 14 blocks breaks the stare. Cooldown 45 s.
message.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider.need_: Only the Rider can do that. Transform first.
message.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider.cycle: There is no room for the Hell Cycle here.
message.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider.stare: The Penance Stare needs solid ground: get off the bike.
No soul to judge in sight.
message.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider.verdi: %s is innocent. The fire passes them by.
%1$s is guilty: %2$s players and %3$s innocents killed, %4$s damage dealt (%5$s sins). Penance: %6$s damage.
death.attack.viltrumitecore.hellfire: %1$s was burned to the soul by hellfire
death.attack.viltrumitecore.hellfire.pla: %1$s was burned to the soul by the hellfire of %2$s
death.attack.viltrumitecore.penance.play: %1$s paid for their sins under the Penance Stare of %2$s
codex.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider.name: Ghost Rider
codex.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider.role: Johnny Blaze, the Spirit of Vengeance on a burning bike
codex.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider.lore: A stunt rider who sold his soul to save his father. By day he is Johnny Blaze in a black leather jacket; when sin is near his flesh burns away to a flaming skull, chains wrap his chest and the Hell Cycle roars out of the fire.
codex.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider.gamepla: Johnny can only summon the Hell Cycle and transform (2 s). The Rider fights with a burning chain: a three-hit lash combo, a hook that pulls bodies in, Chain Whirl ending in a slam, Hellfire Wave, Hell Dash and the Penance Stare, whose damage comes only from the target's real deeds (players and innocents killed, damage dealt). The Hell Cycle is a real bike: throttle, brake, reverse, steering, drifts that fill a boost, jumps and wheelies; riding never breaks blocks and only nudges bystanders aside.
codex.viltrumitecore.ghost_rider.relatio: Once a mortal like any other, and he still remembers it. He burns as hot as the Red Hulk, but his fire judges.
